title: Rows of a linear map: |r| <= ||D|| for every row r, and a row family with sum_j |R_j|^2 = |D|^2
statement: For all n, l in N and every continuous linear map D : R^n -> R^l: (i) for every j in Fin l and every r in R^n with <r, v> = (D v)_j for all v in R^n, |r| <= ||D|| (operator norm); (ii) there is a family (R_j)_{j in Fin l} in R^n with <R_j, v> = (D v)_j for all j in Fin l and v in R^n, and sum_{j in Fin l} |R_j|^2 = hsNormSq D = sum_{i in Fin n} |D e_i|^2 (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), (∀ (j : Fin ℓ) (r : Rn n), (∀ v : Rn n, inner ℝ r v = D v j) → ‖r‖ ≤ ‖D‖) ∧ ∃ R : Fin ℓ → Rn n, (∀ (j : Fin ℓ) (v : Rn n), inner ℝ (R j) v = D v j) ∧ ∑ j : Fin ℓ, ‖R j‖ ^ 2 = hsNormSq D
